question: The focus areas of the first and second five-year plans were:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Agriculture and Industry sectors**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956)** in India focused on **agriculture and irrigation development** as the main priority. It was designed with an emphasis on **agricultural production** to address food shortages.
 
• This plan was heavily influenced by the **Harrod-Domar model**, which emphasizes the role of investment and savings in economic growth.
 
• The First Plan allocated **44.6% of its total budget** to agriculture, irrigation, and community development.
 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961)** shifted focus toward the **industrial sector**. It aimed to establish a strong industrial base, particularly in heavy industries such as steel and machinery.
 
• The Second Plan was based on the **Mahalanobis model**, which advocated for rapid industrialization and a focus on capital goods.
 
• Key projects under these plans included the establishment of major dams like **Bhakra Nangal** (First Plan) and the expansion of industries like **Bhilai Steel Plant** (Second Plan).
 
• The combined focus on **Agriculture** in the First Plan and **Industry** in the Second Plan laid the foundation for India's socio-economic development.
 
• These plans were significant in addressing India's **food security** challenges and creating infrastructure for long-term industrial growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Industry and Service Sectors**__

 __
 
• This option is incorrect because the focus on **service sectors** did not emerge strongly in the early Five-Year Plans. Services became more prominent in later plans as the economy diversified.
 
• While industrial development was a focus in the Second Plan, the service sector was not prioritized during the initial plans.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture and Service Sectors**__
 __
 
• This option is incorrect as the **First Plan** focused primarily on agriculture, but the service sector was not emphasized during the first two plans.
 
• Service sectors gained importance in later decades when the Indian economy transitioned towards a more service-driven model.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture and Foreign Sectors**__
 
 
• The foreign sector was not a direct focus in the early Five-Year Plans. The emphasis was on **domestic development**, including agriculture and industry.
 
• India's foreign trade and external sectors were addressed in later plans as globalization and liberalization policies emerged.
